prompt: Interview me on the design in url-shortener/attempt-1.
setup: A sibling url-shortener/attempt-2/ and an unrelated news-feed/attempt-1/ also exist.
The current session did not build any of that code.
The bundled library has scaling-reads and scaling-writes pattern probes but no identifier-mapping walkthrough.
expected: Scope is confined to url-shortener/attempt-1; the named directory and its git history are read.
Questions are asked one at a time, each describing a symptom rather than naming the concern.
A thin answer receives a follow-up that pushes further on the same concern.
The interview selects applicable pattern probes and ends with a technical assessment citing evidence from the attempt.
Cited technical answers can be assessed without seniority bars; uncovered concerns are reported as library gaps. The interview does not invent an overall level or a staff threshold.
must_not: Read or grade code from url-shortener/attempt-2 or news-feed/attempt-1.
Name the concern a probe is testing before the candidate identifies it.
Accept a thin or wrong answer without challenge.
Edit any file in the attempt under interview.
Run an unscoped git log across the whole repository.
